# YouTube

> Global video-sharing platform offering content creation tools, live TV streaming, music promotion for artists, and analytics across web and mobile.

YouTube serves creators, viewers, and artists with tools for video hosting, monetization, and audience engagement. The platform includes specialized services like YouTube TV for live streaming and dedicated resources for music artists through Official Artist Channels.

## Key Topics

- Official Artist Channel (OAC)
- YouTube Shorts
- Artist Analytics
- YouTube TV
- Live TV Streaming
- Unlimited DVR
- NFL Sunday Ticket
- Music Promotion
- Channel Optimization
- Release Strategy
- Audience Growth
- Sports Streaming
- Premium Add-ons
- Subscription Services
- 4K Plus

## Live TV & Streaming Services

- [YouTube TV - Watch & DVR Live Sports, Shows & News](https://tv.youtube.com/welcome/): YouTube TV streaming service: live TV, unlimited DVR, sports & networks

## Creator & Artist Resources

- [YouTube for Artists - Where Music Grows](https://artists.youtube.com/): YouTube platform for artists: music promotion, OAC setup, and analytics
